primary_contrast: same model + same evidence + same budget, situation off versus on

data.sampling: 30 items per category x 7 categories = 210 items, seed 20260718
data.rendering: evidence-complete: claim text plus bracketed structured metadata (time, validity, status, source, scope, observers); identical evidence block for all conditions
data.v0_1_archive: paper/data/v0.1/ and paper/results/v0.1/ (v0.1 pilot, native Gemini API, 2026-07/08)

provider: openrouter (upstream Google; the native API no longer serves gemini-2.5-flash/-lite to new projects)

fixed_controls.reasoning: disabled ({'enabled': false}); gemini-3.5-flash refuses that and runs at {'effort': 'minimal'}; every recorded call used 0 reasoning tokens
fixed_controls.retries: resumable harness; rerun same command to retry errored calls

scale_and_cost.calls: per model: 630 prompt-condition calls + 210 RAG + agent turns + 36 SituatedQA calls
scale_and_cost.scope: single-provider-family pilot; not the pre-specified multi-family confirmation

commands: python code/run_diagnostic.py && PYTHONPATH=code python code/prepare_llm_eval.py && python code/prepare_rag_eval.py --k 3
python code/run_e5.py   # main conditions for the three models via OpenRouter (needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY)

python code/run_multimodel_eval.py --provider openrouter --model MODEL --data paper/data/situationcatch_rag_sample.jsonl --conditions direct --max-tokens 1024 --out paper/results/raw_rag/e5_SLUG.jsonl

python code/run_multimodel_eval.py --provider openrouter --model MODEL --data paper/data/situatedqa_temporal_sample.jsonl --conditions direct structured situation --max-tokens 1024 --out paper/results/raw_nl/nl_SLUG.jsonl
python code/run_e5.py --provider mock --smoke 5   # harness validation only; never model evidence

smoke_test.result: openrouter adapter verified end-to-end (llama-3.3-70b, gemini-2.5-flash: 8/8 calls scored); openai/gpt-5.1 blocked by HTTP 402 insufficient credits
smoke_test.blockers: OpenRouter credits exhausted (total_credits=0); native GEMINI_API_KEY invalid; xAI team has no credits

pipeline_validation.provider: mock (offline latest-mention text heuristic; reads evidence only, never gold)
pipeline_validation.coverage: 210 items x 6 conditions = 1,260 records, 0 errors; plain/FINAL/JSON extraction paths and aggregation all exercised
pipeline_validation.artifact: paper/results/raw/mock/ (see its README: simulated controls, never model evidence)

driver_validation.checks: credential-free dry-run plans the three Gemini pilot models and three matched conditions from this manifest; missing-key real-run preflight exits 1 with no calls; mock provider remains available for harness-only validation.

free_tier_attempt.target: 21-item stratified pilot (paper/data/situationcatch_free_pilot.jsonl), direct vs situation, qwen3-next-80b:free
free_tier_attempt.result: 0/42 calls succeeded; every :free model returned HTTP 429 (upstream congestion plus zero-credit account daily cap). Error records retained in paper/results/raw/e5_free_pilot_qwen3_next_80b.jsonl per the no-synthetic-results protocol
free_tier_attempt.note: free daily quota resets; a $10 lifetime top-up raises the free-model cap to 1,000 requests/day and unlocks the paid model set

confirmatory_extension.minimum_design: two proprietary and two open-weight model families with matched conditions and budgets
confirmatory_extension.note: Candidate model identifiers must be frozen only when the confirmatory study is run; they are not reported as completed evidence.

v0_2_run.aborted_attempts: paper/results/raw/aborted_substitute_models/ (substitute-model run; native free-tier run stopped at its 20-request daily quota); excluded from all results
